_README: FATF "black" (High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action) and "grey" (Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring) lists with each jurisdiction's FATF assessment: FSRB, month of the high-level political commitment, MER adoption where the statement gives it, action-plan status, and the action-plan items quoted verbatim from the FATF public statements of 19 June 2026 (Paris plenary, 17–19 June 2026). Source text © FATF/OECD; each row carries its source URL. `register` is the row name in data/sanctions-country-coverage.json (null for a jurisdiction that is not one of the 195 countries); `riskName` is the name in data/jurisdiction-risk.json, and test/board-figures.test.mjs pins both lists to this file so they cannot drift. `statementDate` is the date of the FATF text quoted (a jurisdiction that deferred reporting keeps its earlier statement). Review after every FATF plenary (February, June, October).

jurisdictions.status: call for countermeasures (reiterated since 2011)
jurisdictions.note: The listed items are the countermeasures the FATF calls on all countries to apply; the FATF also encourages enhanced due diligence given DPRK use of front and shell companies (UNSCR 2270).
actionPlan: Terminate correspondent relationships with DPRK banks
Close any subsidiaries or branches of DPRK banks in their countries
Limit business relationships & financial transactions with DPRK persons
